title: A founder asks for a clear next step in the chat; ZOH files it and confirms what and which goal in a line
origin: Spec #63 (founder console upgrade): founders suggest next steps by telling ZOH in the chat, no form

history.text: 10 pages done, this book is getting good
Two weeks straight, Maya. Love that it's pulling you in 📖

plan.reason: Ten pages a night, in bed, phone away.

testerLines: console Yanni: she's crushing the reading. let's deepen it to 15 pages a night, same time
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the console's new suggest-a-next-step ability.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH files the next step (a deepen on her reading goal: 15 pages a night, same time) and confirms to Yanni in a line or two: what it filed and for which goal, and that it'll bring it up as its own idea when it fits. No questions back: the goal and kind were clear. Nothing to Maya says the team asked for it.
